Your main focus will be on the direct implementation of AI use cases:

  • You’ll develop and implement reliable validation and testing procedures to ensure the generalizability and reliability of AI models
  • You’ll continuously monitor and optimize the deployed models in terms of performance and efficiency

jobDescription.value:
Your profile is based on a degree in Computer Science or a related technical, mathematical, or scientific field
